description: This file declares the CredentialedUnixServer class, which provides an interface for managing a credentialed UNIX domain socket server, including opening the server, accepting client connections, and retrieving the server's file descriptor.

classes.name: CredentialedUnixServer
classes.description: A class representing a credentialed UNIX domain socket server, providing methods to open the server, accept client connections, and access the server's file descriptor.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Static method to open a credentialed UNIX server at the specified path.

methods.name: AcceptClient
methods.description: Accepts a client connection and returns a file descriptor closer for the client.

methods.name: Fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the server.
